# Saransh Kawadkar — Portfolio

> Saransh Kawadkar is a full-stack software engineer who designs and builds reliable web systems, developer tooling, desktop applications, automation, and blockchain prototypes using React, Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript, Python, C++, Qt, Electron, Flutter, Git, Docker, CMake, and Solidity. This page lists the site's content in a machine- and LLM-friendly format.

- [Home](https://saranshkawadkar.dev/): Overview, featured projects (Slate UI, PRPG, INRT, 3D-MGV), tech stack groups (Web, Desktop, Mobile & Game, Systems & Tools), and contact.
- [About](https://saranshkawadkar.dev/about): Background, skills (React, Next.js, TypeScript, C++, Qt, Python, CMake), work philosophy, and favorite stack.
- [Projects](https://saranshkawadkar.dev/projects): Full list of engineering and product projects with descriptions, technologies, and screenshots.
- [Services](https://saranshkawadkar.dev/services): Engineering services offered — web systems, application development, engineering systems/tooling, problem solving, test automation.
- [Contact](https://saranshkawadkar.dev/contact): Reach out for work, collaboration, or questions.
- [Support](https://saranshkawadkar.dev/support): Support the work via tips.

## Skills & Technologies

Web Development: React, Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, Vue, Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap, HTML, CSS.
Desktop Development: C, C++, Qt6, Python, Electron, CMake.
Mobile & Game Development: Flutter, Unity, Android Studio, Dart.
Systems & Tools: Git, Linux, SQL, Docker, CMake, Solidity.

## Featured Projects

- [Slate UI](https://saranshkawadkar.dev/projects/slate-ui): Native Qt6 desktop chat interface for local LLMs (C++17, CMake, Qt6, llama.cpp).
- [PRPG](https://saranshkawadkar.dev/projects/prpg): Procedural RPG prototype in C++ with OpenGL rendering, SDL2, and local LLM-driven NPCs.
- [INRT](https://saranshkawadkar.dev/projects/inrt): Solana banking prototype (Flutter client, Rust/Anchor on-chain, Bash automation).
- [3D-MGV](https://saranshkawadkar.dev/projects/3d-mgv): Video-to-3D-model pipeline using Python, OpenMVG, OpenMVS, OpenCV, and rembg.

## Services

- [Web Systems](https://saranshkawadkar.dev/services/web-systems): Production-ready front-ends with performance, accessibility, and scalable architecture.
- [Application Development](https://saranshkawadkar.dev/services/application-development): Cross-platform desktop and web applications built with clean architecture.
- [Engineering Systems and Tooling](https://saranshkawadkar.dev/services/engineering-systems-and-tooling): CI/CD, build pipelines, automation, developer tooling.
- [Engineering Problem Solving](https://saranshkawadkar.dev/services/engineering-problem-solving): Debugging, performance optimization, architectural guidance.
- [Test Automation](https://saranshkawadkar.dev/services/test-automation): E2E testing, quality gates, automated verification strategies.
